name: @blcrosbie/yadash
description: Dashboards as YAML. Validate it, compile it to a static page, host it anywhere - and let an agent maintain the config instead of your JSX.

scripts.build:examples: node bin/yadash.mjs build examples/sales.yaml -o dist/sales && node bin/yadash.mjs build examples/support.yaml -o dist/support && node bin/yadash.mjs build examples/ecommerce.yaml -o dist/ecommerce && node bin/yadash.mjs build examples/marketing.yaml -o dist/marketing
